description: Drinking Water - Public Water Systems Rates Information is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California State Water Resources Control Board. Public Water Systems (PWS) submit their annual reports with rate information using the Electronic Annual Report (EAR) submission process on the Drinking Water Information Clearinghouse (DRINC) portal, which is reviewed, and manually updated into the Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS). Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California State Water Resources Control Board. Its tags are CalWater, Drinking Water, water, water rates. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2019-10-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
